bio.text: Chris McGowan, a Sioux City native, announced in June 2025 that he was running as a Republican for Iowa's 4th Congressional District; at the time he was president of the Siouxland Chamber of Commerce.

According to KTIV, he graduated from Heelan High School, earned a bachelor's degree from St. John's University in Minnesota, served in the Iowa Air National Guard, and studied at the Ave Maria School of Law.
He joined The Siouxland Initiative in August 2003 and was promoted to president of the Siouxland Chamber of Commerce and TSI in 2011.
He ran unopposed in the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for the district, according to a later KTIV report.
